The job market is completely broken right now.

536 applications.
500+ ghosted.
Dozens of interviews…
and somehow this is still considered “normal.”

You’ve got:
“You’re the top candidate… but we’re gonna keep looking.”
Canceled interviews last minute
5-hour unpaid “assignments”
And contracts that make it sound like you’re joining the Avengers… to work retail

Meanwhile LinkedIn is over here debating if asking about salary is “rude.”

In this video:

What the job market actually looks like
Why people are so frustrated right now
